plain_statement: For each of the 31 graphs listed in the term: the graphs with no 4-cycle, no isolated vertex and at most 7 vertices whose searches did not finish in both models (one per isomorphism class, 7 to 9 edges), every circuit of AND and OR gates of fan-in at most two computing the function true exactly when both ends of some edge are true has at least s gates, s the number written beside it (edges plus vertex cover number minus one). Every gate counted, inputs not. Conjecture: no search reached s - 1 for these graphs.
title: Edge functions of 31 more small graphs with no 4-cycle: no circuit of AND and OR of fan-in two with fewer than edges + cover - 1 gates
